profile.control_selection_method: Controls were selected according to the MedDefense threat model rather than through blind implementation of the complete CIS Benchmark.

controls.title: Disable SSH password authentication
controls.verification_method: Run sshd -T and confirm passwordauthentication no.
controls.justification: Password-based SSH authentication exposes the servers to brute-force attacks, password spraying and credential reuse.

controls.title: Prohibit direct SSH root login
controls.verification_method: Run sshd -T and confirm permitrootlogin no.
controls.justification: Disabling direct root login requires administrators to authenticate through an attributable account before using sudo.

controls.title: Configure SSH session timeout and authentication limits
controls.verification_method: Use sshd -T to verify clientaliveinterval, clientalivecountmax and maxauthtries.
controls.justification: Idle session termination and authentication limits reduce the opportunity to abuse unattended sessions or repeatedly guess credentials.

controls.title: Enable kernel network-stack protections
controls.verification_method: Query the required net.ipv4 and net.ipv6 parameters using sysctl.
controls.justification: Secure sysctl network settings reduce exposure to spoofing, malicious redirects, source routing and denial-of-service activity.

controls.title: Enable kernel memory protections and restrict core dumps
controls.verification_method: Verify kernel.randomize_va_space, fs.suid_dumpable and core dump limits.
controls.justification: ASLR and core dump restrictions make memory exploitation more difficult and reduce the risk of sensitive information being written to disk.

controls.title: Enforce PAM login attempt limiting
controls.verification_method: Inspect PAM configuration and test repeated failed authentication attempts with a non-production account.
controls.justification: Account lockout or delay controls reduce the number of password guesses available to an attacker.

controls.title: Enforce PAM password quality requirements
controls.verification_method: Inspect pam_pwquality configuration and attempt to set a password that violates the defined policy.
controls.justification: Password length and quality requirements reduce the likelihood that local credentials can be guessed or cracked.

controls.title: Disable unnecessary services
controls.verification_method: Compare systemctl running-service output and listening sockets against the approved service allowlist.
controls.justification: Every unnecessary daemon creates additional code, network exposure and configuration that an attacker may exploit.

controls.title: Restrict database network exposure
controls.verification_method: Use ss -lntup and the database bind-address configuration to confirm that MySQL is not publicly exposed.
controls.justification: The billing database contains sensitive financial and patient information and must only accept connections from explicitly authorized systems.

controls.title: Apply a default-deny host firewall policy
controls.verification_method: Inspect firewall status and confirm that only role-approved ports are permitted.
controls.justification: A default-deny firewall restricts connectivity to explicitly approved services and limits both external exposure and lateral movement.

controls.title: Restrict access to administrative and database ports
controls.verification_method: Review firewall rules and test connectivity from authorized and unauthorized network locations.
controls.justification: Source-based firewall restrictions ensure that SSH, database and logging services are accessible only from trusted systems.

controls.title: Audit and minimize SUID and SGID binaries
controls.verification_method: Use find with -perm -4000 and -perm -2000, then compare results with the approved privileged-binary allowlist.
controls.justification: Unnecessary SUID and SGID permissions can allow a compromised low-privilege account to execute code with elevated privileges.

controls.title: Remediate unsafe world-writable file permissions
controls.verification_method: Search for world-writable files while excluding virtual filesystems and compare the result with approved exceptions.
controls.justification: World-writable files may permit unauthorized users to alter scripts, application content or security-relevant configuration.

controls.title: Enable audit logging for privileged and security-relevant activity
controls.verification_method: Use auditctl -l and ausearch to confirm that privilege use, identity changes and security configuration modifications are recorded.
controls.justification: Security-relevant audit events are required to detect attacker activity, investigate incidents and preserve evidence.

controls.title: Configure secure log retention and rotation
controls.verification_method: Inspect journald, rsyslog and logrotate configuration and verify that retained logs remain available for the approved period.
controls.justification: Defined retention and rotation preserve forensic evidence while preventing uncontrolled log growth from exhausting disk capacity.
